name: stocksync-ai
description: Windows desktop foundation for StockSync AI

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace frontend && npm run sync:once && dotnet build backend/StockSyncAI.slnx --configuration Release --no-restore
scripts.electron:dev: dotnet build backend/StockSyncAI.Api/StockSyncAI.Api.csproj --no-restore && concurrently --kill-others --success first --names vite,electron "npm:dev" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env STOCKSYNC_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron ."
scripts.test: npm run test:node && npm run test --workspace frontend -- --run && dotnet test backend/StockSyncAI.slnx --no-restore
scripts.backend:publish: dotnet publish backend/StockSyncAI.Api/StockSyncAI.Api.csproj --configuration Release --runtime win-x64 --self-contained true --output backend/publish/win-x64
scripts.package:win: npm run build && npm run backend:publish && electron-builder --win nsis
